announcements.headline: Camlipixant phase III results update
announcements.insight: Positive phase III data for Camlipixant addresses the unmet need for non-vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants (NOACs) in patients with severe renal impairment or on dialysis, a high-value niche where GSK faces limited competition. This success de-risks the late-stage pipeline and offers a potential incremental revenue stream in the cardiovascular segment, though it does not offset broader structural headwinds in the pharma sector.
